name: DGME medical and dental college lists — Barishal Division
organization: Directorate General of Medical Education (DGME), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Source: Directorate General of Medical Education (dgme.gov.bd)
notes: Same DGME HTML tables as the Rajshahi, Rangpur, Dhaka, Chattogram and Khulna runs: 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি মেডিকেল কলেজ' (college code, name, year established, MBBS seats; page updated 18 Dec 2025) and 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি ডেন্টাল কলেজ/ইউনিট' (updated 20 May 2024). Rows kept when the name's district suffix (or a district name in it) is in Barishal Division. The Sher-e-Bangla Medical College dental unit (listed without a district suffix) is attached to its parent college by exact name. English names/websites for government colleges come from the 'সরকারী মেডিকেল কলেজ (সকল)' page, matched by district where the district has one government MBBS college (Barishal: Sher-E-Bangla Medical College; Patuakhali: Patuakhali Medical College). No addresses, phones or coordinates. Licence not stated.
